Adamantite armor is a Hardmode armor set consisting of the Adamantite Breastplate and Adamantite Leggings, as well as three different headpieces: the Adamantite Helmet, Adamantite Mask, and Adamantite Headgear, providing bonuses for the melee, ranged, and magic damage type respectively. Crafting a full set with one headpiece requires a total of 54 Adamantite Bars (216 Adamantite Ore). Crafting all five pieces requires a total of 78 Adamantite Bars (312 Adamantite Ore).

Its alternate ore counterpart is the Titanium armor.

The full set grants the following effects while equipped:

With HelmetWith MaskWith Headgear

  • +50 defense
  • +22% melee damage (+14% melee; +8% for all damage types)
  • +14% melee critical strike chance (+7% melee; +7% for all damage types)
  • +20% melee speed
  • +25% movement speed

  • +36 defense
  • +22% ranged damage (+14% ranged; +8% for all damage types)
  • +17% ranged critical strike chance (+10% ranged; +7% for all damage types)
  • +25% ammo conservation
  • +5% movement speed

  • +32 defense
  • +20% magic damage (+12% magic; +8% for all damage types)
  • +19% magic critical strike chance (+12% magic; +7% for all damage types)
  • +80 maximum mana
  • +19% mana cost reduction
  • +5% movement speed

The player also emits a faint pulsating aura.

Tips[edit]

  • When compared to Titanium armor, Adamantite armor grants higher offensive stats overall:
    • The melee set for Adamantite provides more damage bonuses including extra melee speed when compared to Titanium. It also provides 1 more defense.
    • The ranged set for Adamantite provides less damage boosts over Titanium, but has higher critical strike chance, and has a 25% chance not to consume ammo (set bonus). It also provides 2 more defense.
    • The magic set for Adamantite provides less damage boosts than Titanium, but does offer more critical strike chance and mana boosts when the set bonus is considered. It also provides 2 more defense.
  • While Adamantite armor might be chosen because it provides higher offensive stats than Titanium armor, it does not provide the highest offensive stats available within its progression tier. If the goal is simply to maximize damage output using mixed armor setups is advised:
    • Melee and ranged users can maximize their offensive bonuses by equipping a Frost Breastplate and Mythril Greaves while keeping the Adamantite Mask or Helmet in the head slot.
    • Adamantite armor is a decent choice for magic users, who might appreciate the full set's defense and mana cost reduction. Those who are more confident in their dodging skills can maximize their offense with a set consisting of Adamantite Headgear, Mystic Robe, and Forbidden Treads.
  • Melee players may not find it worth it to upgrade to Hallowed armor, as Adamantite armor has the same amount of defense (50) and higher raw damage increase. However, it could be worth crafting the Hallowed armor for the Holy Protection buff and stat bonuses more broadly applicable to melee weapons in general rather than swords/spears.
  • If one is not exclusively using a specific type of weapon for Shroomite armor, the Adamantite Mask provides the best single piece offensive bonuses for rangers for the rest of Hardmode.

Trivia[edit]

  • Both the Headgear and Helmet versions have more defense than the equivalent sets of Titanium armor, which makes it the only original armor set to have more defense than its alternative.
  • While the Adamantite Mask appears to provide the greatest face protection and looks similar to many other melee-specialized masks, it has lower defense than the Adamantite Helmet and provides ranged bonuses.
  • The full Adamantite set equipped with the Helmet looks similar to Crimson armor.

History[edit]

 Desktop version
  • Desktop 1.4.1:
    • Adamantite Breastplate damage bonus increased from 6% to 8%.
    • Adamantite Leggings critical chance bonus increased from 4% to 7%.
    • Adamantite Helmet set bonus (melee/movement speed boost) increased from 18% to 20%.
    • Adamantite Mask ranged critical chance increased from 8% to 10%.
    • Adamantite Headgear magic damage increased from 11% to 12% and magic critical chance increased from 11% to 12%.
  • Desktop 1.3.2: Sprite updated.
  • Desktop 1.3.0.1:
    • Adamantite Breastplate defense increased from 14 to 16.
    • Adamantite Leggings defense increased from 10 to 12.
